title: Inference
description: The models a machine uses for a knowledge base: the providers it reaches, and which provider and model serve each role. A knowledge base's repository may carry several, one for each provider, and a machine chooses one.

spec.description: The providers, and who serves each role.

providers.description: Each provider a role names, and how it is reached.

roster.description: The provider and model serving each role: every job a worker does, and each Librarian actor that asks a model.
